scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml -f compose.hostdev.yml up -d postgres doc-engine mailpit
scripts.dev:infra:down: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml -f compose.hostdev.yml stop postgres doc-engine mailpit
scripts.stack:reset: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml down -v && pnpm stack
scripts.openapi: turbo run build --filter=@openlaw/api... && pnpm --filter @openlaw/api openapi:emit && pnpm --filter @openlaw/api-client generate && prettier --write apps/api/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.ts
scripts.fix: pnpm lint:fix && pnpm format && pnpm secretlint && turbo run typecheck --continue
scripts.check: pnpm check:static && pnpm test:ci-tools && turbo run test --continue
scripts.check:static: pnpm format:check && pnpm secretlint && pnpm lint:contrast && pnpm lint:migrations && pnpm lint:versions && turbo run lint typecheck --continue
